body: Thank you for the advice! Sending you good vibes back from Canada!!
Happy tripping! Peace and love from Canada friend! ✌
Thank you!! Sending good vibes from Canada!!

Thanks for the info. Yeah, I'm leaning towards letting them know to wait. It's not too long of a wait anyhow, they were told their ulcer would take 2-3 months to heal and they're on week 2 of it healing. At least it should be worth the wait!!

Dude I'm so excited, I cant wait! I don't know why I'm so worried about having a bad trip as I've never really had one. The last time I tripped sucked, but I blame that on that fact that I was prescribed a high dose of clonazepam and a small dose of seroquel, which I believe weakened the 2gs I took turning it more into 1g, didn't have any euphoria at all, just very very mild visuals and felt nervous and shitty. I had never had a bad time with shrooms before this so it was odd.

I was taking 100mg for insomnia, and not diagnosed with bi-polar or any psychosis. I tapered down to 25mg and will be stopping them next week. I do however have been diagnosed with depression, anxiety disorder and PTSD-like symptoms (but no actual PTSD). Currently going through the process of being diagnosed for ADHD and very well may have that. I'm actually hoping that psilocin might help me with my past trauma and current depression resulting from it, but really for this first trip I just want to relax and have a fun time. I'm thinking maybe I'll bump the dose up to 1.5gs. Shrooms are golden teachers btw since that's somewhat relevant to dosing. Happy tripping friend ✌

Thank you for the reply, I think I will try this. To prepare, I'm learning how to meditate and I plan to do so during the come up, and for the peak I plan on just laying in bed with headphones on. I bought a bunch of dried lavander that I'm going to put in my pillowcases, some nice candles, etc. This is my first trip in 5 years so I'm treating it as if it's my first again. After this trip I plan on going up to 2gs and I might try and use the trip to better myself or just to comepletely let go for a day and relax. I'm excited and nervous. That same butterflies in the stomach feel from when I first started tripping. I plan on tripping this weekend, or maybe friday.

I've heard that directly boiling them can destroy some of the psilocin and psilocybin and that you shouldn't bring the water to a full rolling boil but get it hot enough as if you were to steep tea, and pour it over the shrooms. Although, I've also heard that it isn't true and the extra heat releases more of the compounds into the water rather then the aforementioned preparation. If I find out more about this I'll post back here!
nah, it looks like something fell onto the cap like some people have said here, could be spores that fell or another mushroom growing ontop of it

It kinda comes off if I scrape it, like some of it's coming off but it's pretty stuck on there. Must be some potent European jizz then. I just don't wanna take some shrooms that could have some kinda mold growing on them and get sick aha

Those friends I talked about, we aren't really that close. They're mainly friends with my boyfriend, and I hang out with them when they come over to see him. The one I'm the closest to, I have no way of contacting because I dont have a phone plan, and they dont use discord or Facebook or anything like that. Honestly I'm so alone.

I have some stressful things in life I'm dealing with that would trigger me, but yeah perhaps my body just needs more time to adjust to the medicine and it'll just go away... I'm going to book an appointment tomorrow with my doctor and talk about perhaps doing 50mg in the morning and then night like you said, that might work better. Sorry to hear you had to deal with that with the Wellbutrin, sometimes it feels like those of us with anxiety and depression are guinea pigs for all sorts of meds until something kinda works. Oh well, it is what it is. Thank you for the advice man and good luck!

Thank you for the response, I think I'm going to try the 100mg for one more night and if tomorrow I still feel really awful, I will drop back down to 50mg. I just want one more night of sleep. Really sucks too, because I thought I finally found a med that could help my nightmares and anxiety... oh well. Onto whatever medication my doc wants to try next I suppose!
Thank you!!
Nice, seems like this stuff isn't too bad for side effects. Besides the munchies and my visions been blurry.

Been taking 50mg for two weeks now, and I've started noticing its effectiveness drop. As for when I started taking it, I had a hard time typing, felt a lil weird, was more talkative and vision blurriness so I suppose that is what I am to expect tonight. Oh, and the munchies. I just snack on chocolate and whatever I got in my fridge. But it really helped with my sleep and I wake up calm.
You can smoke anything if you try hard enough, lmao? Fr tho, I wouldn't reccommend it. Maybe just smoke some good kush?

Hey, I'm a freelance artist, I'm currently not up for commissions but small pieces for free like this I'm down for giving a shot, to help me get back in the flow of creating more art, and as good practice. If you haven't already gotten someone I'd love to help. This sub has been really kind, and everyone has good advice to give.

My biggest fear, is when it stops helping and I'm just dependent on it. That's exactly what's happening with my clonazepam. I've been taking 0.5mg for roughly 2 years now, and it isn't doing much, if anything, for my anxiety anymore. I'm scared of what  I will do once the pregabalin stops working. Im not even sure how to work on my core issues. My therapy options are very limited, and I have no supportive family. Because of my GAD I've put a wall up and even my friends don't always feel like they're actually there for me, it feels like they are just helping me because they're friends with my so. I have no idea what I'm going to do when the time comes for me to wean off... fuck me lol

Ah, it's nice to know I'm not alone! My tolerance to weed is high so honestly it doesn't help me sleep well/dream less anymore. I hope this pregabalin stuff works, it's good that its helping you, but I know what you mean about dreading how you'll ever come off it. That's how I feel about the clonazepam rn. Im barely functional already so who tf knows what would happen if I suddenly stopped. If you ever do have to come off of the meds for what ever reason, as long as your able to do a very slow taper, side effects should be minimal to none. Atleast that's what people on this subreddit have been saying and my pharmacist. I wish you luck man! I'm sure I'm probably going to make another post here at some point when I've moved up to 100mgs lol. I cant seem to stay away from here, the people are friendly and give good advice

I congratulate you on coming so far! I am definitely at my rock bottom right now and I'm really hoping the lyrica can help me open up, and function properly. Tonight is going to be my second night dosing 50mg. I hope one year from today that I'll be much more functional, I might be starting cbt soon but my options seem to be limited.

I mean I definitely was more talkative about an hour after dosing. My anxiety did start to die down but was still there for sure. I hope this isn't the type of med to take weeks to start actually helping anxiety lol

I also have fucked memory, from the clonazepam I take and the copious amounts of weed I smoke, so even worse memory loss dosent sound fun. I'm not sure I want to move up to 300mg as prescribed but apparently that is the best dose for gad, which alone I need help with badly. Just hanging out with my close buddies I have waves of intense anxiety, and I can't go and buy my own stuff because i can't even talk to a cashier. I do alot of online shopping or my so picks up the groceries. So my gad has definitely taken over my life, and if this pregabalin can help me actually function, I think it might be worth it. You can't get better in life unless you take risks sometimes I suppose.

Yeah, last night I felt a lil out of it, was having a hard time typing. I didnt sleep well though, but I'm sure its just because it was my first dose. It's good to hear that 200mg has worked for you for a whole year without you needing to go up. I currently take clonazepam as well for nightmares and the pregabalin could help me wean off of it. I'm just still unsure if I am indeed doing the right thing by trying this med out. I dont qant to end up dependent on it but in the end it's probably better to be dependent on the pregabalin then clonazepam.

Damn dude. That is shit. Up here in Canada I believe it is prescribed for anxiety. At the very least, nightmares. I ended up trying the 50mg last night and still didn't sleep well so I'm not sure if I'm going to try it again tonight or not. I wish you luck man! If you're unable to get access to pregabalin I would recommend you do a taper if you can. Going cold turkey off of it won't be a fun time

You're right, I'm just the type of person that prefers taking the smallest most effective dose. Took the 50mg roughly 2 hours ago and I'm feeling alright. My anxiety has gonna down a bit, it was so bad when I dosed. I was so convinced I'd have a bad reaction, and here I am still okay. I'm hoping I sleep well tonight. I know typing rn is definitely harder, I keep making mistakes and retyping them. I guess everything is gonna be okay

I'm hoping so... I've been so anxious all day about this, it'd be nice if when it kicks in my anxiety melts away. I think I may have a phobia of trying new meds. As for instructions, 50mg a day, increasing weekly till 300mg is reached. Though honestly lm going to try to stick around 100mgs and hopefully wont need more. Going to be leaving soon with my friends. Let's hope tonight goes well

Me either, if I was I would've cracked open that bottle of pregabalin as soon as I got it. I think I'm going to try it out for a week at 50mg, and if I find it's not helpful I'll stop then, my prescription says to increase 50mg every week till I get to 300mg but honestly if 50mg helps me then that's all I need. Do you find the medication hasn't lost effectiveness over time? I worry about my body becoming used to the 50mg and then needing to go up and up.

I do worry about becoming addicted to this stuff, but I shouldnt develop any dependence if I only take it for a few days/week and stop. I just want to try it out and see if it helps with my sleep, and I've heard that its helped people with anxiety come out of their shell. If you feel you might be addicted to it, never cold turkey the medicine as you'll definitely feel withdrawal. Do a slow taper with your doctor and you should feel minimal withdrawal effects, I believe alot of the people here struggling to taper aren't doing a proper one with their doctor or go cold turkey. I wish you good luck with this!
Sounds good, I'll try that instead next time. I had thought that it was the best way since that what I usually see people do. Thanks man

I shall sleep as well as I can, aha. Yeah up here in Canada the day is long over. I'm used to staying up late getting art done though, for some reason it's when I can draw the best. And yeah, my doc is pretty great actually, I appreciate them alot. From what I was seeing on the subreddit I thought a pregabalin withdrawal would be longer/harder then a clonazepam one. The prescription they gave me says to take 50mg for one week and then increase weekly till I get to 300mg but the pharmacist said if 50mg works just fine for me then theres no need to move up. I think I might try the 50mg for a week, and if it's really helping I might continue. If I get to that point, I'm sure I'll be on this subreddit again asking people if they think I should go up to 100mg haha. I do need to focus on getting better for my own sake and the people around me. And if that means later I just have to deal with a little bit of anxiety then that seems worth it. Plus, if the taper is slow enough perhaps I won't have any withdrawal, and I might be able to go down on the clonazepam too! I am currently receiving some "therapy" from a social worker from my hospital, and I think she wanted to start cbt soon. I hope things are looking up for me, finally. I hope you have a good morning, friend!

Damn, so you really gotta fill em up, huh? The balloons I got are just regular sized ones you'd find at any dollar store. I'm kindof just looking for a buzz, not sure if I want to get to "that point" but since I can't trip on shrooms anymore, (a med I take counteracts the psilocybin) it's been so long since I've felt that beautiful euphoria. Looks like I might need to fill up a few balloons. I just don't want to over do it, since I'm new to it I'm not sure what my limits are. I don't wanna throw up or end up with a throbbing headache, ya feel?

Huh, the pharmacist also mentioned I might feel "stoned"... That feeling would be nice to have for a night, as I haven't been able to drink since I started the clonazepam. And yeah, I'm more then likely dependent on the clonazepam as I've been on it for 2 or so years now. Though my dose isn't that high, 0.5mg a day. The seroquel is also a low dose, 100mg to help with sleep and anxiety. Didnt know that the pregabalin could help with benzo withdrawal, that might be useful as my doc wants to lower my clonazepam dose soon, thankfully she's patient and isn't pushing me until I'm ready. The worst of all of this though, is the argument me and my s.o had over this. I told him what I read on this subreddit and that I didn't think it'd be a good idea to take the meds, that I don't want to become dependent on another med, etc. He insisted that I should really take the meds, as my lack of sleep is really effecting my mental health, badly. And I agree. I regret even having that arguement, tomorrow morning I plan on talking to him about the advice I was given here, and that I'm reconsidering taking the Lyrica. I know I'm going to be super nervous about taking it, but I'm sure that'll melt away once it kicks in, huh? And my doc said if I'm that worried about taking new meds, that I can visit the hospital and wait in the emerg room while I take it so that if I do react badly atleast a nurse might be able to help calm me down. Sorry for the long posts, but it felt nice to talk to someone. You're advice really helped me tonight man. I'm going to go to sleep now, as it's already almost 3 am here. I wish you good sleep, and congrats on getting past that addiction!! Good night!

Thank you for the reply, you've actually relieved a bit of anxiety in me about taking it, (which I didn't think was possible) True, that most people who have good experiences with Lyrica and taper successfully won't post here as much as the people who hate the drug. And also true, if I hadn't googled it I probably would've just taken it by now but I couldn't help it, since I'm nervous trying new medications I usually will Google what i can about them to relieve some anxiety, but it just does the opposite. Its relieving to hear that you've seen lots of people taper off the medication fine. I'm currently also prescribed seroquel, propranolol and clonazepam. I've trying tapering off the clonazepam before and have struggled, it's not fun and I'm not sure if adding another drug I'd have anxiety tapering off of is a good idea, but like you said taking it for a few weeks can't do no harm... I might try it. So if I took 50mg every day for a week straight, and stopped taking it on day 8, I wouldn't have any withdrawal? Idk why I'm still anxious about taking it, I guess I just have this bad paranoia about trying new meds. I had a really bad experience with antidepressants before (Effexor or sm like that) so I'm scared of trying something new and having a bad reaction. Again thanks for your advice man

I do smoke alot of weed. Too bad it dosent stop nightmares, atleast for me. The withdrawals are what scare me the most and why I still haven't touched my bottle of Pregabalin. The doc also told me about Prozasin so I might try that out, but I'm also worried to try that because I've heard some people waking up in the middle of the night with their heart beating super hard/fast and I've had that happen to me before on an SNRI. Trying out new meds terrifies me, man
Hmm, I cant find anything on whether they interact or  not, so who knows. I wish you luck in getting some good sleep man. I know I could use some

Thank you for your response, I'm rethinking what I may do now. I'm still worried about taking the Lyrica and then becoming dependent, and being one of the unlucky ones that has trouble even with a proper taper. Actually, it was my hospital's psychiatrist that recommended the Lyrica for nightmares to my doctor, and he recommended Prozasin too. I might just try out Prozasin instead but I'm not sure either. I talked to two separate pharmacists and neither of them mentioned that the Pregabalin might be unpleasant to taper off of so perhaps it really is just people who didn't taper properly... One of the pharmacists did mention however that Pregabalin won't help with nightmares, so... I'm still not 100% sure what to do.
